
### flows / packets 

![](/intro/texfig/flows-flows--packets.figure-1.svg){fig-alt="Diagram showing data going via two switches from machine 1 to machine 2. The diagram shows the flow being divided into variably-sized pieces, some of which are in transit on links between nodes and some of which are in queues on the switches."}


### flows  {.smaller}


* flow = data flowing ‘together’ across a network
* often different ways of dividing data into flows 

   * if we need precision, we'll define it more precisely

* flow divided into packets/frames/segments 

   * best name depends on which layer we're looking at
   * won't be picky about it because the world isn't
